key_concepts: Magnetic materials include iron, nickel, steel, and some metal objects
Magnets have an invisible magnetic field
The ends of a magnet are called poles
Magnetic poles exert a force that can pull together or push apart
Magnetic force is the push or pull of a magnet
Magnets do not attract all metals
Magnetic force is strongest between the two poles of a magnet
The magnetic field is the area around a magnet where magnetic force acts
Same magnetic poles repel while unlike poles attract
Magnetic field lines are closer near the poles and spread out farther away
Closer magnetic field lines indicate a stronger magnetic field
Magnetic force is related to magnetic field lines
